Run many simulations of the 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/run_batch.R
run_batch.Rd

run_batch runs a set of simulations (e.g. different sites, scenarios, management options or species parameters), each one in its own directory, sequentially or in parallel. The input files are copied for each run, so the simulations do not interfere with each other.

Usage

run_batch(
  runs,
  inputdir = NULL,
  outputdir,
  ...,
  parallel = FALSE,
  stop_on_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

runs

data.frame with one row per simulation. Columns named as the arguments of run_3DCMCCFEM (e.g. site, year_end, man, co2) set that argument for the run. A column inputdir gives a different input directory to each run (e.g. different sites). A column id names the runs (default run_001, run_002, ...). Any other column named as a parameter of the species file (e.g. LIGHT_TOL) changes that parameter, for all the species of the run, in the copy of the species files.

inputdir

Character: input directory used by the runs without an inputdir column.

outputdir

Character: directory of the runs. Each run is saved in outputdir/id/input and outputdir/id/output. Keep it short: the model cannot write paths longer than 260 characters.

...

Arguments of run_3DCMCCFEM common to all runs (e.g. species, year_start, output).

parallel

Logical: run the simulations in parallel with the future framework (package future.apply)? The future plan set by the user is used, e.g. future::plan("multisession", workers = 4). Default to FALSE

stop_on_error

Logical: stop at the first failed simulation? Default to FALSE: errors are reported in the result.

Value

A data.frame with the columns of runs and the columns id, status ("ok" or "error"), message (error message) and output (path of the main output file, to be read with read_output).

See also

run_3DCMCCFEM, param_sensitivity

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inp <- system.file("extdata", "bilykriz", "rcp0p0", package = "R3DFEM")
res <- run_batch(data.frame(co2 = c("on", "off")), inputdir = inp,
                 outputdir = "C:/sim/co2", site = "BilyKriz",
                 species = "Piceaabies", year_start = 1997, year_end = 2050,
                 man = "off", output = "annual")
out <- read_output(res$output)
} # }
